scope: Independent source review of the exact frozen r01 projections and actual rendered topic rows and entry reading text for the 15 shared canonical entries and their 29 placements in the 6–9-month and 18–24-month pilots. This reviewer authored none of these entries and did not inspect the final tone review. No shared placement contains an opening, scene or art context. Source meaning, attribution, public qualifications, references, and age/readiness/editorial placement are assessed separately from manuscript polish.

reviewInputs.renderedReadMethod: Personally read every shared canonical full entryText and all 29 placements’ actual topic-row text from RENDERED_SURFACES.json, together with their frozen age labels, kinds, topics, cues, public age notes, principles and reference labels. The two age versions have identical full entryText; each placement’s selected age and topic routes were separately checked in the actual rendered HTML. Read the actual renderer to establish what a topic row omits. No opening or image is present for this batch. File and component hashes bind the reading; hash checks themselves are not semantic approval.

readScope: Personally read the complete text on the 68 Baby and 57 Toddler original physical PDF pages enumerated below, and 30 complete readable original-page visuals. textPlacement.assessment: The title, summary and cue invite factual observation without a diagnostic or milestone claim. The detail keeps self-observation, informal observation and available help/protection alongside the books’ careful watching. The references identify complete observation passages and the factual-description basis; the short topic summary does not turn observation into a mandatory delay. The 6–9-month placement under For you & your family; Play & discovery is supported by Baby’s infant/family context and the entry’s general meaning. It is editorial reuse at this age, not a book-stated month-specific ability or readiness requirement. The actual topic rows were assessed with only their rendered kind, title and summary; the source meaning does not depend on opening the detail to recover a missing qualification. The full reading view and structured PDF reference labels preserve the reviewed source support.
